notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Join our Discord an sign up for Alpha an get the news first!

notes.title: SURVIVAL JOURNALS IS HERE/Join Our Discord Server!
notes.content:
After years of hard work we're finally ready to show you guys what we've been up to. Here's Survival Journals;

https://store.steampowered.com/app/792380/Survival_Journals/


A game that combines classic CYOA style gameplay with RPG and Strategy elements, we have a lot more info coming your way soon but for now all the info we can share is in the Store Page :)

You can join our Discord Server ; https://discord.gg/bYrraSA

To participate in Closed Alpha's, giveaways and even a chance to have your store/story idea featured in the game!

Don't forget to add us to your wishlisht and follow our Steam Developer Page!

We'll be back with more soon™,

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
The infamous "bedbug" was fixed after one and a half year thanks to the great feedback of Pelican! 

Diner chase event won't happen twice.

Also couple other minor fixes.

notes.title: Now with Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
After an unfortunate hard drive failure most of the game's "original" files were lost. But I was able to recover them after a loong time. 

Having the "original" files allowed me to integrate Steam Achievement. Try them now!


And I'd like to say thank you to everyone's support up to this point. It's been one hell of a ride. I will anounce my new game in the next couple of months(hopefully) and I promise that I won't make the easy mistakes I did with Hotel Anatolia. (Using a dated and "less capable" engine for example)

For new comers that have no idea what I'm talking about you can check the first anouncement of Hotel Anatolia right [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/601010/announcements/detail/484540733149998548] here. [/url]

Thank you all once again!

notes.title: Çıkış Yaklaşırken
notes.content: Oyunun çıkmasına yalnızca bir gün kalmışken geliştirme süreciyle ilgili biraz arkaplan bilgisi vermek istedim. Anadolu Oteli bir geliştiricinin oyun geliştirmeye attığı ilk adımdır. İki saate yakın oynanış süresiyle yılın oyunu olmayı vaad etmemekle beraber zamanınıza değecek kadar içerik bulundurmaktadır. Fiyatı kasten düşük tutulmuştur ki mümkün olan en çok kişi erişebilsin, yorumlarıyla düşünceleriyle bu ilk adımın sağlamlığına katkı sağlayabilsin. Oyunu oynayanların geri bildirim sağlamalarını(e-posta ve/veya Steam İncelemeri aracılığıyla) rica ediyor, süreç boyunca destek olan herkese teşekkür ediyorum.

notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.content: Since there is only one day left for release I wanted to give a little background about the development. Hotel Anatolia is a new  developer's first step into developing games. It has about two hours of content, it doesn’t promise you a Game of The Year experience though it has enough content to make it worth your time. Due to Hotel Anatolia being first game of a developer it has a very accessible price so that you can give feedback easily and support the game with your feedback. I thank everyone who supported the game during its development and strongly urge you to give feedback via e-mail and/or steam reviews.
